name: long source with a leading space
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - {type: bind, source: " /../appfiles/x/mail-admin", target: /x, read_only: true}
want: can't start or end with whitespace

name: long source with a leading tab
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - {type: bind, source: "\t/../secrets", target: /x}
want: can't start or end with whitespace

name: long source with a leading NBSP
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - {type: bind, source: "\u00a0/../.env", target: /x}
want: can't start or end with whitespace

name: long source with a trailing newline
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - {type: bind, source: "./templates/app/x\n", target: /x, read_only: true}
want: can't start or end with whitespace

name: long source with a control character
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - {type: bind, source: "./templates/app/\u0001x", target: /x}
want: can't start or end with whitespace

name: long target with a leading space
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - {type: bind, source: ./templates/app/x, target: " /x"}
want: can't start or end with whitespace

name: short entry with a leading space
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - " ./templates/app/x:/y"
want: can't start or end with whitespace

name: short target with a leading space
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - "./templates/app/x: /y"
want: can't start or end with whitespace

name: short entry with a control character
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - "./templates/app/x\u0007:/y"
want: can't start or end with whitespace

name: untrimmed own files ok
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - ./templates/app/x:/y:ro
      - {type: bind, source: ./templates/app/x, target: /x}

name: CA bundle ro,Z
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - ./certs/ca-bundle.crt:/ca.crt:ro,Z

name: CA bundle ro,z
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - ./certs/ca-bundle.crt:/ca.crt:ro,z

name: CA bundle bind.selinux
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - {type: bind, source: ./certs/ca-bundle.crt, target: /ca.crt, read_only: true, bind: {selinux: Z}}

name: CA bundle ro ok
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - ./certs/ca-bundle.crt:/ca.crt:ro
      - {type: bind, source: ./certs/ca-bundle.crt, target: /c2.crt, read_only: true}

name: own files keep their own relabel ok
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - ./templates/app/x:/y:ro,z

name: ro and rw
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - ./templates/app/x:/y:ro,rw

name: rw and ro
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - data:/y:rw,ro

name: CA bundle read_only string
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - {type: bind, source: ./certs/ca-bundle.crt, target: /ca.crt, read_only: "true"}

name: relative without ./
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - appfiles/stalwart/mail-admin:/x:ro

name: external volume
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - shared:/s
volumes:
  shared:
    external: true
    name: foreign_vol

name: external false ok
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - shared:/s
volumes:
  shared:
    external: false

name: a service that isn't a mapping
compose:
services:
  web: [a, b]

name: duplicate key by text
compose:
services:
  web:
    image: x
    volumes:
      - data:/d
x-a: 1
"x-a": 2
